'''Luisa Cifarelli [[FInstP]]''' (born 11 June 1952) is a Professor of Experimental Particle Physics at the [[University of Bologna]]. She is the Director of the La Rivista del Nuovo Cimento.

== Early life and education ==
Cifarelli was born in Rome in 1952, daughter of [[Michele Cifarelli]], an Italian politician and magistrate. She studied physics at the [[University of Bologna]] and graduated in 1975. She worked as a researcher in at the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] and [[CERN]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://congresso.sif.it/associazione/elezioni/cifarelli/cv|title=Luisa Cifarelli - Curriculum Vitae {{!}} Congresso Nazionale SIF|website=congresso.sif.it|access-date=2019-01-24}}</ref> She edited the collection of scientific studies for the publication ''QCD at 200 TeV''.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=UvTlBwAAQBAJ&q=Luisa+Cifarelli|title=QCD at 200 TeV|last1=Cifarelli|first1=L.|last2=Dokshitzer|first2=Y.|date=2012-12-06|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=9781461534402|language=en}}</ref> In 1988 she was made an associate professor at [[:it:L'Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II|L'Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II]].

== Career ==
Cifarelli was appointed full Professor at the [[University of Pisa]] in 1991.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luisa.cifarelli/cv-en|title=Luisa Cifarelli â€" University of Bologna â€" Curriculum vitae|website=www.unibo.it|access-date=2019-01-24}}</ref> She moved to the [[University of Salerno]] in 1993. She works at [[CERN]], the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso]], [[DESY]] and the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luisa.cifarelli/en|title=Luisa Cifarelli â€" University of Bologna â€" Home Page|website=www.unibo.it|access-date=2019-01-24}}</ref> She has been involved in the design and construction of the [[ALICE experiment]], which studies [[proton]]-proton and [[Atomic nucleus|nucleus]]-nucleus collisions at extreme energies. She was made Head of the [[ALICE experiment|ALICE]] Data Analysis and Simulation Group in 2000.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Cifarelli_Luisa|title=Academy of Europe: Cifarelli Luisa|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2019-01-24}}</ref> She served as Deputy Chairperson of the [[Time of flight detector|time of flight]] experiment at [[ALICE experiment|ALICE]].<ref name=":0" /> She used the [[ALICE experiment]] to study quark-gluon interactions. She coordinates the [[Extreme Energy Events]] experiments, which uses muon detectors in high schools around Italy to study [[Cosmic ray|cosmic swarms]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rdeditore.it/jl/100-eccellenze-italiane/protagonisti-ed-3/537-luisa-cifarelli.html|title=Protagonisti 3^ Edizione|last=Marino|first=Riccardo|website=www.rdeditore.it|language=it-it|access-date=2019-01-24}}</ref> She serves on the DarkSide project; a 20 tonne Two-Phase LAr TPC for Direct Dark Matter Detection at the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Aalseth|first1=C. E.|last2=Acerbi|first2=F.|last3=Agnes|first3=P.|last4=Albuquerque|first4=I. F. M.|last5=Alexander|first5=T.|last6=Alici|first6=A.|last7=Alton|first7=A. K.|last8=Antonioli|first8=P.|last9=Arcelli|first9=S.|date=March 2018|title=DarkSide-20k: A 20 Tonne Two-Phase LAr TPC for Direct Dark Matter Detection at LNGS|journal=The European Physical Journal Plus|volume=133|issue=3|pages=131|doi=10.1140/epjp/i2018-11973-4|issn=2190-5444|arxiv=1707.08145|bibcode=2018EPJP..133..131A|s2cid=119067979}}</ref>
